page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 8 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPU hardware, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable processing capabilities.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 CPU-to-memory ratio positions this instance as a compute-focused resource, minimizing memory overhead costs for CPU-bound tasks. The dedicated physical cores make it suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without hyperthreading interference, such as batch processing, web serving, and lightweight computational tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is a compute-focused virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with a single thread per core, ensuring consistent processing performance without resource sharing. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. This hardware profile is designed for workloads that prioritize dedicated CPU execution over high memory capacity or local storage speed. The ecs.c1.large is suitable for batch processing, dedicated web servers, and computational tasks that benefit from dedicated physical cores.
